svg.title: Pavan Kumar Balijepalli
svg.desc: An ASCII self-portrait drawn like chalk on navy, beside the name Pavan Kumar Balijepalli, the line 'building things that think, ship, and hold up in production', Lead Data Scientist / AI Lead at Cigna, 7+ years in AI/ML, and a terminal: shipping agentic systems, studying M.Tech AIML at BITS Pilani, guest lecturing at BITS Pilani WILP, TeLLM and phi2-sqlcoder on Hugging Face.
svg.text: building things that think, ship, and hold up in production.
